question: ‘2 States’ is a novel written by whom among the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chetan Bhagat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chetan Bhagat** is the author of the novel "**2 States**".
 
• The novel is a fictional story about a couple from different states in India, who face challenges in convincing their parents to accept their relationship.
 
• Chetan Bhagat is known for his contemporary novels that often explore themes of love, youth, and aspirations in modern India.
 
• "2 States" was also adapted into a successful Bollywood film, further popularizing the story.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chetan Bhagat is one of India's best-selling authors and has written several other popular novels like** "Five Point Someone," "One Night @ the Call Center," and "The 3 Mistakes of My Life."**
 
• His books often reflect the aspirations and challenges of the Indian middle class, making them relatable to a wide audience.
 
• Besides being an author, Chetan Bhagat is also a columnist and motivational speaker.
 
• He has received numerous awards and accolades for his contributions to literature and entertainment.
